transition_rules: lease_expiry = now + lease_duration with checked u32 arithmetic
expired LEASED rows are reclassified to PENDING in the same transaction
a successful claim changes PENDING to LEASED exactly once
attempt_count increases by one and rejects u32 exhaustion
semantic effect_id and payload fields are read from the committed atom
a lease timeout cannot synthesize a new semantic effect ID
active leases reject another worker without changing durable state
transaction_rule: BEGIN IMMEDIATE plus conditional status/owner/expiry/attempt CAS
reaper_rule: reclaim_expired_outbox_leases returns expired rows to PENDING atomically
nonclaims: no acknowledgment provenance or lost-ack recovery
no production datastore or runtime mounting
